 // Unix timestamp describing when the price was published\n        uint publishTime;\n    }\n\n    // PriceFeed represents a current aggregate price from pyth publisher feeds.\n    struct PriceFeed {\n        // The price ID.\n        bytes32 id;\n        // Latest available price\n        Price price;\n        // Latest available exponentially-weighted moving average price\n        Price emaPrice;\n    }\n\n    struct TwapPriceFeed {\n        // The price ID.\n        bytes32 id;\n        // Start time of the TWAP\n        uint64 startTime;\n        // End time of the TWAP\n        uint64 endTime;\n        // TWAP price\n        Price twap;\n        // Down slot ratio represents the ratio of price feed updates that were missed or unavailable\n        // during the TWAP period, expressed as a fixed-point number between 0 and 1e6 (100%).\n        // For example:\n        //   - 0 means all price updates were available\n        //   - 500_000 means 50% of updates were missed\n        //   - 1_000_000 means all updates were missed\n        // This can be used to assess the quality/reliability of the TWAP calculation.\n        // Applications should define a maximum acceptable ratio (e.g. 100000 for 10%)\n        // and revert if downSlotsRatio exceeds it.\n        uint32 downSlotsRatio;\n    }\n\n    // Information used to calculate time-weighted average prices (TWAP)\n    struct TwapPriceInfo {\n        // slot 1\n        int128 cumulativePrice;\n        uint128 cumulativeConf;\n        // slot 2\n        uint64 numDownSlots;\n        uint64 publishSlot;\n        uint64 publishTime;\n        uint64 prevPublishTime;\n        // slot 3\n        int32 expo;\n    }\n}\n","keccak256":"0x474436bf0d558cc9b2c00a9d0ce318147acdf7963f34ef4acadb9248e65bbc7b","license":"Apache-2.0"},"contracts/ClimbLadder.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-3-Clause-Clear\npragma solidity ^0.8.27;\n\nimport {ClimbPriceOracle} from \"./ClimbPriceOracle.sol\";\n\n/// @title ClimbLadder\n/// @notice The rules of a Siroclimb run, in clear: given a market's oracle checkpoints between a\n///         run's entry and its exit, what would a long and what would a short have made?\n///\n/// Every move between two consecutive checkpoints counts `moveScale(market)` times (the game boost, set per\n/// market for its volatility: a quiet market gets a bigger boost so every market moves alike on screen) at\n/// the leverage of the ladder step the move began on: 1x, 1.5x, 2x ... 4x, one step every 6 seconds\n/// from the start. PnL adds up on the stake, like a position of constant notional; when\n/// it reaches -100 % the coin falls and the run is worth 0 for good.\n///\n/// Both results are public (anyone can recompute them from the oracle); which one a player gets\n/// depends on their encrypted side, which only the game contract combines on ciphertexts.\ncontract ClimbLadder {\n    uint8 public constant TOP_STEP = 6;\n    uint64 public constant STEP_SECONDS = 6;\n    /// @notice Multipliers are fixed point with 6 decimals: 1_000_000 = the stake back.\n    uint32 public constant SCALE = 1_000_000;\n    uint32 public constant MAX_MULT = 10 * SCALE;\n    /// @notice A single checkpoint-to-checkpoint move is clamped to +/-20 % before scaling.\n    int256 public constant MAX_SEGMENT_MOVE = 200_000;\n    /// @notice Bound on the checkpoints a run reads (the oracle writes at most one per block).\n    uint256 public constant MAX_PATH = 64;\n\n    ClimbPriceOracle public immutable oracle;\n    /// @notice Game boost per market: how many times a real price move counts, before leverage.\n    uint32[] private _moveScales;\n\n    error BadScales();\n\n    constructor(ClimbPriceOracle oracle_, uint32[] memory moveScales_) {\n        if (moveScales_.length == 0) revert BadScales();\n        for (uint256 i; i < moveScales_.length; ++i) if (moveScales_[i] == 0 || moveScales_[i] > 1000) revert BadScales();\n        oracle = oracle_;\n        _moveScales = moveScales_;\n    }\n\n    /// @notice The game boost of `market`.\n    function moveScale(uint256 market) public view returns (uint32) {\n        return _moveScales[market];\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Every market's game boost, in market order.\n    function moveScales() external view returns (uint32[] memory) {\n        return _moveScales;\n    }\n\n    /// @notice The ladder in tenths of x: 10, 15, 20 ... 40.\n    function ladder() external pure returns (uint8[7] memory tenths) {\n        for (uint8 i; i <= TOP_STEP; ++i) tenths[i] = 10 + 5 * i;\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Value / stake (6 decimals) of a long and of a short that entered at checkpoint\n    ///         `entryIndex` at time `start` and left at checkpoint `exitIndex`, the ladder capped\n    ///         at `capStep`. Index bounds (not times) make the result reproducible by anyone, even\n    ///         when another checkpoint lands later in the block of a cash out.\n    function multipliers(\n        uint256 market,\n        uint256 entryIndex,\n        uint256 exitIndex,\n        uint64 start,\n        uint8 capStep\n    ) external view returns (uint32 multLong, uint32 multShort, uint64 exitPrice) {\n        uint256 count = exitIndex >= entryIndex ? exitIndex - entryIndex + 1 : 1;\n        if (count > MAX_PATH) count = MAX_PATH;\n        (uint64[] memory ts, uint64[] memory px) = oracle.path(market, entryIndex, type(uint256).max, count);\n        int256 one = int256(uint256(SCALE));\n        int256 scale = int256(uint256(moveScale(market)));\n        int256 accL;\n        int256 accS;\n        bool fellL;\n        bool fellS;\n        for (uint256 j = 1; j < ts.length; ++j) {\n            int256 move = ((int256(uint256(px[j])) - int256(uint256(px[j - 1]))) * one) / int256(uint256(px[j - 1]));\n            if (move > MAX_SEGMENT_MOVE) move = MAX_SEGMENT_MOVE;\n            if (move < -MAX_SEGMENT_MOVE) move = -MAX_SEGMENT_MOVE;\n            // the leverage of a move is the leverage when the move began (the previous checkpoint), so the\n            // value at a cash out is known at the click: the last move runs at the current step\n            uint64 step = (ts[j - 1] > start ? ts[j - 1] - start : 0) / STEP_SECONDS;\n            if (step > capStep) step = capStep;\n            int256 d = (move * scale * int256(uint256(10 + 5 * step))) / 10;\n            if (!fellL) {\n                accL += d;\n                if (accL <= -one) fellL = true;\n            }\n            if (!fellS) {\n                accS -= d;\n                if (accS <= -one) fellS = true;\n            }\n        }\n        multLong = _mult(fellL, accL);\n        multShort = _mult(fellS, accS);\n        exitPrice = px[px.length - 1];\n    }\n\n    function _mult(bool fell, int256 acc) private pure returns (uint32) {\n        if (fell) return 0;\n        int256 m = int256(uint256(SCALE)) + acc;\n        if (m <= 0) return 0;\n        if (m > int256(uint256(MAX_MULT))) return MAX_MULT;\n        return uint32(uint256(m));\n    }\n}\n","keccak256":"0x06485d99f665546b09aae0926e9f04d3a25c9b112945add98985f680bbc71ce6","license":"BSD-3-Clause-Clear"},"contracts/ClimbPriceOracle.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-3-Clause-Clear\npragma solidity ^0.8.27;\n\nimport {Ownable2Step, Ownable} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable2Step.sol\";\nimport {IPyth} from \"@pythnetwork/pyth-sdk-solidity/IPyth.sol\";\nimport {PythStructs} from \"@pythnetwork/pyth-sdk-solidity/PythStructs.sol\";\n\n/// @title ClimbPriceOracle\n/// @notice Per-market, append-only price checkpoints for Siroclimb runs.\n///\n/// A run is settled on the checkpoints that were on chain between its entry and its exit, so the\n/// result never depends on when settlement is called. Every checkpoint carries the block time at\n/// which it was written (not the time the price was observed), which makes \"the prices known at\n/// time t\" deterministic.\n///\n/// Three ways to write a checkpoint, each tagged with its source:\n///  - `pushPyth` (anyone, trustless): a signed Pyth Hermes update is posted to the Pyth contract\n///    (Wormhole-verified); every market whose feed is fresh after the update takes its price.\n///    The players' browsers (and the game itself on entry and cash out) do this.\n///  - `pushPublic` (anyone, bounded fallback): for a market without a fresh Pyth price (feed not\n///    covered by the Hermes plan, or Pyth down), public market data is accepted at most every\n///    `PUBLIC_MIN_SPACING` seconds, within `PUBLIC_MAX_MOVE_BPS` of the last checkpoint and within\n///    `PUBLIC_MAX_PYTH_DRIFT_BPS` of the last Pyth checkpoint (if one is recent). Reporters are\n///    semi-trusted within those bounds; the source of every checkpoint is public.\n///  - `pushPrices` (authorised updaters): seeding at deployment and the optional ops keeper.\n///\n/// Prices use 10 decimals (sub-cent tokens keep precision, BTC still fits a uint64).\ncontract ClimbPriceOracle is Ownable2Step {\n    uint256 public constant PRICE_DECIMALS = 10;\n\n    uint8 public constant SOURCE_KEEPER = 0;\n    uint8 public constant SOURCE_PYTH = 1;\n    uint8 public constant SOURCE_PUBLIC = 2;\n\n    /// @notice A Pyth price older than this (vs the block time) is not taken.\n    uint256 public constant PYTH_MAX_AGE = 25;\n    /// @notice Public checkpoints are refused while the market has a Pyth checkpoint this recent.\n    uint256 public constant PYTH_FRESH = 120;\n    uint256 public constant PUBLIC_MIN_SPACING = 10;\n    uint256 public constant PUBLIC_MAX_MOVE_BPS = 50; // 0.5 % vs the last checkpoint\n    uint256 public constant PUBLIC_MAX_PYTH_DRIFT_BPS = 300; // 3 % vs the last Pyth checkpoint\n    /// @notice The Pyth drift bound only applies while the last Pyth checkpoint is this recent.\n    uint256 public constant PYTH_DRIFT_WINDOW = 1 hours;\n\n    struct Checkpoint {\n        uint64 timestamp;\n        uint64 price;\n        uint8 source;\n    }\n\n    IPyth public immutable pyth;\n    uint256 public immutable marketCount;\n    bytes32[] private _feedIds;\n\n    mapping(uint256 market => Checkpoint[]) private _checkpoints;\n    /// @notice 1 + index of the last Pyth checkpoint of a market (0 = none yet).\n    mapping(uint256 market => uint256) public lastPythPlusOne;\n    mapping(address account => bool) public isUpdater;\n\n    error NotUpdater(address account);\n    error UnknownMarket(uint256 market);\n    error ZeroPrice(uint256 market);\n    error NoCheckpoint(uint256 market);\n    error NoCheckpointBefore(uint256 market, uint256 timestamp);\n    error TooSoon(uint256 market, uint256 nextAt);\n    error PythIsFresh(uint256 market);\n    error PriceJump(uint256 market);\n    error LengthMismatch();\n\n    event UpdaterSet(address indexed account, bool allowed);\n    event PricePushed(uint256 indexed market, uint256 indexed index, uint64 timestamp, uint64 price, uint8 source);\n\n    constructor(address owner_, IPyth pyth_, bytes32[] memory feedIds_) Ownable(owner_) {\n        pyth = pyth_;\n        marketCount = feedIds_.length;\n        _feedIds = feedIds_;\n    }\n\n    modifier onlyUpdater() {\n        if (!isUpdater[msg.sender]) revert NotUpdater(msg.sender);\n        _;\n    }\n\n    function setUpdater(address account, bool allowed) external onlyOwner {\n        isUpdater[account] = allowed;\n        emit UpdaterSet(account, allowed);\n    }\n\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- writes\n\n    /// @notice Trusted checkpoints (deployment seed, optional keeper).\n    function pushPrices(uint256[] calldata markets, uint64[] calldata prices) external onlyUpdater {\n        if (markets.length != prices.length) revert LengthMismatch();\n        for (uint256 i; i < markets.length; ++i) {\n            _checkMarket(markets[i]);\n            if (prices[i] == 0) revert ZeroPrice(markets[i]);\n            _append(markets[i], prices[i], SOURCE_KEEPER);\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Posts a signed Pyth update (pays the Pyth fee, refunds the rest to the caller) and\n    ///         writes a checkpoint for every market whose Pyth price is now fresh. Never reverts\n    ///         because a market had nothing new, so it can ride along with game transactions.\n    /// @return mask bit i set when market i got a new Pyth checkpoint.\n    function pushPyth(bytes[] calldata updateData) external payable returns (uint256 mask) {\n        uint256 fee = pyth.getUpdateFee(updateData);\n        pyth.updatePriceFeeds{value: fee}(updateData);\n        for (uint256 i; i < marketCount; ++i) {\n            if (_feedIds[i] == bytes32(0)) continue;\n            Checkpoint[] storage cps = _checkpoints[i];\n            if (cps.length != 0 && cps[cps.length - 1].timestamp >= block.timestamp) continue; // one per block\n            try pyth.getPriceNoOlderThan(_feedIds[i], PYTH_MAX_AGE) returns (PythStructs.Price memory p) {\n                uint64 price = _toFixed10(p);\n                if (price == 0) continue;\n                _append(i, price, SOURCE_PYTH);\n                lastPythPlusOne[i] = cps.length;\n                mask |= 1 << i;\n            } catch {}\n        }\n        if (msg.value > fee) {\n            (bool ok, ) = msg.sender.call{value: msg.value - fee}(\"\");\n            ok;\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Bounded fallback checkpoints from public market data, callable by anyone.\n    function pushPublic(uint256[] calldata markets, uint64[] calldata prices) external {\n        if (markets.length != prices.length) revert LengthMismatch();\n        for (uint256 i; i < markets.length; ++i) {\n            uint256 m = markets[i];\n            _checkMarket(m);\n            Checkpoint[] storage cps = _checkpoints[m];\n            uint256 n = cps.length;\n            if (n == 0) revert NoCheckpoint(m);\n            Checkpoint storage last = cps[n - 1];\n            if (block.timestamp < last.timestamp + PUBLIC_MIN_SPACING) revert TooSoon(m, last.timestamp + PUBLIC_MIN_SPACING);\n            if (prices[i] == 0) revert ZeroPrice(m);\n            if (!_within(prices[i], last.price, PUBLIC_MAX_MOVE_BPS)) revert PriceJump(m);\n            uint256 lp = lastPythPlusOne[m];\n            if (lp != 0) {\n                Checkpoint storage py = cps[lp - 1];\n                if (block.timestamp < py.timestamp + PYTH_FRESH) revert PythIsFresh(m);\n                if (block.timestamp < py.timestamp + PYTH_DRIFT_WINDOW && !_within(prices[i], py.price, PUBLIC_MAX_PYTH_DRIFT_BPS))\n                    revert PriceJump(m);\n            }\n            _append(m, prices[i], SOURCE_PUBLIC);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- views\n\n    function feedIds() external view returns (bytes32[] memory) {\n        return _feedIds;\n    }\n\n    function checkpointCount(uint256 market) external view returns (uint256) {\n        return _checkpoints[market].length;\n    }\n\n    function getCheckpoint(uint256 market, uint256 index) external view returns (Checkpoint memory) {\n        return _checkpoints[market][index];\n    }\n\n    /// @notice The last checkpoint of a market.\n    function latest(uint256 market) public view returns (uint256 index, uint64 timestamp, uint64 price, uint8 source) {\n        uint256 n = _checkpoints[market].length;\n        if (n == 0) revert NoCheckpoint(market);\n        Checkpoint storage c = _checkpoints[market][n - 1];\n        return (n - 1, c.timestamp, c.price, c.source);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Latest checkpoint of every market (timestamps and prices), for the front.\n    function latestAll() external view returns (uint64[] memory timestamps, uint64[] memory prices, uint8[] memory sources) {\n        timestamps = new uint64[](marketCount);\n        prices = new uint64[](marketCount);\n        sources = new uint8[](marketCount);\n        for (uint256 i; i < marketCount; ++i) {\n            uint256 n = _checkpoints[i].length;\n            if (n == 0) continue;\n            Checkpoint storage c = _checkpoints[i][n - 1];\n            (timestamps[i], prices[i], sources[i]) = (c.timestamp, c.price, c.source);\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Index of the last checkpoint written at or before `timestamp` (binary search).\n    function indexAtOrBefore(uint256 market, uint256 timestamp) public view returns (uint256) {\n        Checkpoint[] storage cps = _checkpoints[market];\n        uint256 n = cps.length;\n        if (n == 0 || cps[0].timestamp > timestamp) revert NoCheckpointBefore(market, timestamp);\n        uint256 lo = 0;\n        uint256 hi = n - 1;\n        while (lo < hi) {\n            uint256 mid = (lo + hi + 1) / 2;\n            if (cps[mid].timestamp <= timestamp) lo = mid;\n            else hi = mid - 1;\n        }\n        return lo;\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Checkpoints from index `from` on, as long as they were written at or before `until`,\n    ///         at most `max` of them. Element 0 is checkpoint `from` itself.\n    function path(\n        uint256 market,\n        uint256 from,\n        uint256 until,\n        uint256 max\n    ) external view returns (uint64[] memory timestamps, uint64[] memory prices) {\n        Checkpoint[] storage cps = _checkpoints[market];\n        uint256 n = cps.length;\n        uint256 end = from;\n        while (end < n && end - from < max && (end == from || cps[end].timestamp <= until)) ++end;\n        timestamps = new uint64[](end - from);\n        prices = new uint64[](end - from);\n        for (uint256 i = from; i < end; ++i) {\n            timestamps[i - from] = cps[i].timestamp;\n            prices[i - from] = cps[i].price;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- internals\n\n    function _checkMarket(uint256 market) private view {\n        if (market >= marketCount) revert UnknownMarket(market);\n    }\n\n    function _append(uint256 market, uint64 price, uint8 source) private {\n        Checkpoint[] storage cps = _checkpoints[market];\n        uint256 n = cps.length;\n        // at most one checkpoint per market and block: bounds the path of a run and keeps time strictly increasing\n        if (n != 0 && cps[n - 1].timestamp >= block.timestamp) revert TooSoon(market, cps[n - 1].timestamp + 1);\n        cps.push(Checkpoint({timestamp: uint64(block.timestamp), price: price, source: source}));\n        emit PricePushed(market, n, uint64(block.timestamp), price, source);\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Pyth price (mantissa x 10^expo) to 10-decimal fixed point; 0 when unusable.\n    function _toFixed10(PythStructs.Price memory p) private pure returns (uint64) {\n        if (p.price <= 0) return 0;\n        int256 shift = int256(PRICE_DECIMALS) + int256(p.expo);\n        uint256 v = uint256(uint64(p.price));\n        if (shift >= 0) v *= 10 ** uint256(shift);\n        else v /= 10 ** uint256(-shift);\n        if (v > type(uint64).max) return 0;\n        return uint64(v);\n    }\n\n    function _within(uint64 a, uint64 b, uint256 bps) private pure returns (bool) {\n        uint256 diff = a > b ? a - b : b - a;\n        return diff * 10_000 <= uint256(b) * bps;\n    }\n}\n","keccak256":"0x130dfb74da3a7d441c2aa3dc6bbce9c2f62acf0bc6b25067f3ca2480623d2456","license":"BSD-3-Clause-Clear"},"contracts/SiroccoDesk.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-3-Clause-Clear\npragma solidity ^0.8.27;\n\nimport {FHE, ebool, euint64} from \"@fhevm/solidity/lib/FHE.sol\";\nimport {ZamaEthereumConfig} from \"@fhevm/solidity/config/ZamaConfig.sol\";\nimport {Ownable2Step, Ownable} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable2Step.sol\";\nimport {IERC20} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol\";\nimport {SafeERC20} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/utils/SafeERC20.sol\";\nimport {IERC7984} from \"@openzeppelin/confidential-contracts/interfaces/IERC7984.sol\";\nimport {IERC7984ERC20Wrapper} from \"@openzeppelin/confidential-contracts/interfaces/IERC7984ERC20Wrapper.sol\";\n\n/// @title SiroccoDesk\n/// @notice The Sirocco desk: where Siroclimb runs buy, sell, borrow and return the markets' real\n///         confidential tokens (cTSLAx, cNVDAx, cAAPLx, cAMZNx, cXAUt, ctGBP). It holds inventories\n///         of every market token and of cUSDC, quotes at the oracle price plus or minus `spreadBps`,\n///         and lends its token inventory to shorts (its token-lending book).\n///\n/// Every amount is encrypted: quantities are `notional x 1e10 / price` on ciphertexts at a public\n/// price (`FHE.mul`, `FHE.div` by a plaintext). The side is an encrypted bool and both legs of a\n/// trade always move, one of them with an encrypted 0, so an observer sees the same transfers for a\n/// long and a short:\n///  - open: the desk sends the run `qty` tokens (a long buys them at the ask; a short borrows them),\n///    the run pays `long ? notional : 0` cUSDC and sends back `long ? 0 : qty` tokens (a short sells\n///    what it borrowed), the desk pays `long ? 0 : qty x bid` cUSDC;\n///  - close: the run sends back `long ? qty : 0` tokens (a long sells them; a short's buy-back and\n///    return cancel out), the desk pays `long ? qty x bid : 0` cUSDC, the run pays `long ? 0 : qty x ask`.\n/// What is public: which market, when, and the public prices. Quantities, cash amounts and the side\n/// are not. The desk's inventories are encrypted balances, readable by its owner only.\n///\n/// Only the game may trade (`setGame`, once). The game makes the desk its ERC-7984 operator for cUSDC\n/// and every market token, so the desk pulls the run's legs itself.\ncontract SiroccoDesk is ZamaEthereumConfig, Ownable2Step {\n    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;\n\n    /// @notice Prices have 10 decimals; token amounts have 6 (cUSDC and every market token).\n    uint64 public constant PRICE_ONE = 1e10;\n    uint16 public constant BPS = 10_000;\n\n    IERC7984 public immutable cash;\n    /// @notice Half spread around the oracle price, in basis points: ask = price + spread, bid = price - spread.\n    uint16 public immutable spreadBps;\n    address public game;\n\n    error NotGame();\n    error GameAlreadySet();\n    error BadSpread();\n\n    event GameSet(address indexed game);\n    event Opened(uint256 indexed runId, address indexed token, uint64 price, bytes32 qtyHandle);\n    event Closed(uint256 indexed runId, address indexed token, uint64 price);\n    event Stocked(address indexed token, uint256 publicAmount);\n\n    constructor(address owner_, IERC7984 cash_, uint16 spreadBps_) Ownable(owner_) {\n        if (spreadBps_ >= BPS) revert BadSpread();\n        cash = cash_;\n        spreadBps = spreadBps_;\n    }\n\n    modifier onlyGame() {\n        if (msg.sender != game) revert NotGame();\n        _;\n    }\n\n    function setGame(address game_) external onlyOwner {\n        if (game != address(0)) revert GameAlreadySet();\n        game = game_;\n        emit GameSet(game_);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice The desk's quotes around a public price.\n    function quotes(uint64 price) public view returns (uint64 bid, uint64 ask) {\n        bid = uint64((uint256(price) * (BPS - spreadBps)) / BPS);\n        ask = uint64((uint256(price) * (BPS + spreadBps)) / BPS);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Opens a run's position in `token` at `price`. `notional` is the cUSDC the run puts in\n    ///         (stake plus what it borrowed). Returns the tokens the run holds (long) or owes (short),\n    ///         and its cash leg: what a long paid, or what a short's sale brought in.\n    function open(\n        uint256 runId,\n        IERC7984 token,\n        ebool long,\n        euint64 notional,\n        uint64 price\n    ) external onlyGame returns (euint64 qty, euint64 cashLeg) {\n        (uint64 bid, uint64 ask) = quotes(price);\n        euint64 zero = FHE.asEuint64(0);\n        // a long buys at the ask; a short borrows the same quantity, then sells it at the bid\n        qty = _send(token, msg.sender, FHE.div(FHE.mul(notional, PRICE_ONE), ask));\n        euint64 proceeds = FHE.div(FHE.mul(qty, bid), PRICE_ONE);\n        _pull(cash, msg.sender, FHE.select(long, notional, zero));\n        _pull(token, msg.sender, FHE.select(long, zero, qty));\n        _send(cash, msg.sender, FHE.select(long, zero, proceeds));\n        cashLeg = FHE.select(long, notional, proceeds);\n        FHE.allowTransient(qty, msg.sender);\n        FHE.allowTransient(cashLeg, msg.sender);\n        emit Opened(runId, address(token), price, FHE.toBytes32(qty));\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Closes a run's position at `price`: a long sells its `qty` at the bid, a short buys\n    ///         `qty` back at the ask and returns it. Returns what came in and what went out for the\n    ///         run over its whole life: (long: sale, cost) or (short: sale at the open, buy-back).\n    function close(\n        uint256 runId,\n        IERC7984 token,\n        ebool long,\n        euint64 qty,\n        euint64 cashLeg,\n        uint64 price\n    ) external onlyGame returns (euint64 cashIn, euint64 cashOut) {\n        (uint64 bid, uint64 ask) = quotes(price);\n        euint64 zero = FHE.asEuint64(0);\n        euint64 sale = FHE.div(FHE.mul(qty, bid), PRICE_ONE);\n        euint64 buyBack = FHE.div(FHE.mul(qty, ask), PRICE_ONE);\n        _pull(token, msg.sender, FHE.select(long, qty, zero));\n        sale = _send(cash, msg.sender, FHE.select(long, sale, zero));\n        buyBack = _pull(cash, msg.sender, FHE.select(long, zero, buyBack));\n        cashIn = FHE.select(long, sale, cashLeg);\n        cashOut = FHE.select(long, cashLeg, buyBack);\n        FHE.allowTransient(cashIn, msg.sender);\n        FHE.allowTransient(cashOut, msg.sender);\n        emit Closed(runId, address(token), price);\n    }\n\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- inventory (owner)\n\n    /// @notice Stocks the desk with `amount` of an ERC-7984 wrapper's public underlying (pulled from the\n    ///         caller, wrapped here). The amount is public anyway (an ERC-20 transfer).\n    function stock(IERC7984ERC20Wrapper wrapper, uint256 amount) external {\n        IERC20 underlying = IERC20(wrapper.underlying());\n        underlying.safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), amount);\n        underlying.forceApprove(address(wrapper), amount);\n        wrapper.wrap(address(this), amount);\n        emit Stocked(address(wrapper), amount);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Lets the owner decrypt the desk's current balance of `token`.\n    function revealInventoryTo(IERC7984 token, address viewer) external onlyOwner returns (euint64 balance) {\n        balance = token.confidentialBalanceOf(address(this));\n        FHE.allow(balance, viewer);\n    }\n\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- internals\n\n    function _send(IERC7984 token, address to, euint64 amount) private returns (euint64 sent) {\n        FHE.allowTransient(amount, address(token));\n        sent = token.confidentialTransfer(to, amount);\n    }\n\n    function _pull(IERC7984 token, address from, euint64 amount) private returns (euint64 moved) {\n        FHE.allowTransient(amount, address(token));\n        moved = token.confidentialTransferFrom(from, address(this), amount);\n    }\n}\n","keccak256":"0x9d35a6f4b230c4dd97f3cd31f6985e63335585f726c3b761b8f9baf072a90a7e","license":"BSD-3-Clause-Clear"},"contracts/SiroccoReserve.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-3-Clause-Clear\npragma solidity ^0.8.27;\n\nimport {FHE, ebool, euint64, euint128, externalEuint64} from \"@fhevm/solidity/lib/FHE.sol\";\nimport {ZamaEthereumConfig} from \"@fhevm/solidity/config/ZamaConfig.sol\";\nimport {Ownable2Step, Ownable} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable2Step.sol\";\nimport {IERC20} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol\";\nimport {SafeERC20} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/utils/SafeERC20.sol\";\nimport {ERC7984} from \"@openzeppelin/confidential-contracts/token/ERC7984/ERC7984.sol\";\nimport {IERC7984ERC20Wrapper} from \"@openzeppelin/confidential-contracts/interfaces/IERC7984ERC20Wrapper.sol\";\n\n/// @title SiroccoReserve\n/// @notice The Sirocco Reserve: a confidential cUSDC lending pool that funds Siroclimb's leverage.\n///\n/// Lenders deposit cUSDC and receive reserve shares, an ERC-7984 token (`rcUSDC`): every share\n/// balance is encrypted. A share is worth `syncedAssets / syncedShares` cUSDC: the reserve's\n/// assets grow with the borrow interest players pay and with the stakes they lose, and shrink with\n/// what they win, so lenders carry the game's PnL.\n///\n/// Leverage: a run of stake S at leverage L has a notional of S x L, of which S x (L - 1) is\n/// borrowed from the reserve; the borrowed amount climbs with the ladder. S is encrypted, so the\n/// reserve commits liquidity in clear with the public bound of a run: at the start it lends\n/// `MAX_PAYOUT` (what a 100 cUSDC stake can be paid at most) into the game as an encrypted transfer\n/// of a public amount, and the game sends back `stake + lent - payout` at the end. Each live run is\n/// thereby fully funded on its own: whatever lenders withdraw meanwhile, the payout of a live run is\n/// already in the game. If the reserve cannot lend the full amount, the transfer moves 0 (ERC-7984)\n/// and the run is a plain refund, without leverage; the outcome stays encrypted.\n///\n/// What is public, what is not:\n///  - deposit and withdrawal amounts and every lender's shares: encrypted. Withdrawals are\n///    all-or-nothing on ciphertexts (enough shares, enough free cUSDC), so a failed one moves 0;\n///  - the reserve's total assets, total shares and total interest earned: encrypted between syncs,\n///    revealed together at most every `SYNC_INTERVAL` by public decryption, checked on chain with\n///    the KMS proof (`finalizeSync`). Share price, TVL and APY come from these synced aggregates;\n///  - the liquidity committed to live runs (`lockedAssets`, the public bound per run): public.\n///    Utilization is `lockedAssets / syncedAssets`.\ncontract SiroccoReserve is ERC7984, ZamaEthereumConfig, Ownable2Step {\n    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;\n\n    /// @notice Aggregates are revealed at most this often, so one sync mixes many runs and flows.\n    uint64 public constant SYNC_INTERVAL = 10 minutes;\n    /// @notice A sync the KMS never answered can be requested again after this long.\n    uint64 public constant SYNC_TIMEOUT = 1 hours;\n    uint256 private constant YEAR = 365 days;\n\n    /// @notice Zama's confidential USDC (ERC-7984 wrapper of USDCMock on Sepolia).\n    IERC7984ERC20Wrapper public immutable asset;\n    /// @notice Borrow rate charged on the borrowed part of a run, per year, in basis points.\n    uint16 public immutable borrowAprBps;\n    /// @notice The game allowed to borrow (set once).\n    address public game;\n\n    /// @notice cUSDC committed to live runs (clear: the public bound of each run).\n    uint256 public lockedAssets;\n    uint256 public openLoans;\n\n    // encrypted running totals (6 decimals)\n    euint64 private _outstanding; // lent to live runs and not back yet (uninitialized = 0)\n    euint64 private _interest; // borrow interest earned since launch (uninitialized = 0)\n\n    // last synced aggregates (public, KMS-verified)\n    uint64 public syncedAssets;\n    uint64 public syncedShares;\n    uint64 public syncedInterest;\n    uint64 public syncedAt;\n    uint64 public syncRequestedAt;\n    bytes32[3] private _pending; // assets, shares, interest handles of the requested sync\n\n    error NotGame();\n    error GameAlreadySet();\n    error SyncTooSoon(uint256 availableAt);\n    error NoSyncPending();\n    error ReserveFull(uint256 locked, uint256 assets);\n    error ZeroAmount();\n\n    event GameSet(address indexed game);\n    event Deposited(address indexed lender, bytes32 sharesHandle, uint256 publicAmount);\n    event WithdrawRequested(address indexed lender, bytes32 sharesHandle, bytes32 assetsHandle);\n    event Lent(uint256 indexed runId, bytes32 lentHandle, uint256 lockedAssets);\n    event Repaid(uint256 indexed runId, uint256 lockedAssets);\n    event SyncRequested(uint64 at, bytes32 assetsHandle, bytes32 sharesHandle, bytes32 interestHandle);\n    event Synced(uint64 at, uint64 assets, uint64 shares, uint64 interest);\n\n    constructor(\n        address owner_,\n        IERC7984ERC20Wrapper asset_,\n        uint16 borrowAprBps_\n    ) ERC7984(\"Sirocco Reserve cUSDC\", \"rcUSDC\", \"\") Ownable(owner_) {\n        asset = asset_;\n        borrowAprBps = borrowAprBps_;\n        IERC20(asset_.underlying()).forceApprove(address(asset_), type(uint256).max);\n    }\n\n    modifier onlyGame() {\n        if (msg.sender != game) revert NotGame();\n        _;\n    }\n\n    function setGame(address game_) external onlyOwner {\n        if (game != address(0)) revert GameAlreadySet();\n        game = game_;\n        emit GameSet(game_);\n    }\n\n    function decimals() public pure override returns (uint8) {\n        return 6;\n    }\n\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- lenders\n\n    /// @notice Deposits an encrypted amount of cUSDC (the reserve must be the caller's ERC-7984\n    ///         operator) for shares at the synced price.\n    function deposit(externalEuint64 amount, bytes calldata inputProof) external returns (euint64 shares) {\n        euint64 a = FHE.fromExternal(amount, inputProof);\n        FHE.allowTransient(a, address(asset));\n        euint64 moved = asset.confidentialTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), a);\n        shares = _mint(msg.sender, _toShares(moved));\n        emit Deposited(msg.sender, FHE.toBytes32(shares), 0);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Deposits a public amount of the underlying USDC (wrapped into cUSDC here). The\n    ///         amount is public anyway (an ERC-20 transfer), so the synced totals follow it at once.\n    function depositUnderlying(uint256 amount) external returns (euint64 shares) {\n        uint256 rate = asset.rate();\n        uint64 units = uint64(amount / rate);\n        if (units == 0) revert ZeroAmount();\n        IERC20(asset.underlying()).safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), uint256(units) * rate);\n        asset.wrap(address(this), uint256(units) * rate);\n        uint64 s = syncedShares == 0 ? units : uint64((uint256(units) * syncedShares) / syncedAssets);\n        shares = _mint(msg.sender, FHE.asEuint64(s));\n        syncedAssets += units;\n        syncedShares += s;\n        emit Deposited(msg.sender, FHE.toBytes32(shares), units);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Redeems an encrypted number of shares at the synced price. All or nothing on\n    ///         ciphertexts: the caller must hold the shares and the reserve must hold the cUSDC\n    ///         outside live runs; otherwise nothing moves (both amounts stay encrypted).\n    function withdraw(externalEuint64 shares, bytes calldata inputProof) external returns (euint64 out) {\n        euint64 s = FHE.fromExternal(shares, inputProof);\n        euint64 owed = _toAssets(s);\n        ebool ok = FHE.and(FHE.le(s, confidentialBalanceOf(msg.sender)), FHE.le(owed, asset.confidentialBalanceOf(address(this))));\n        euint64 burned = _burn(msg.sender, FHE.select(ok, s, FHE.asEuint64(0)));\n        out = FHE.select(ok, owed, FHE.asEuint64(0));\n        FHE.allowTransient(out, address(asset));\n        out = asset.confidentialTransfer(msg.sender, out);\n        FHE.allow(out, msg.sender);\n        emit WithdrawRequested(msg.sender, FHE.toBytes32(burned), FHE.toBytes32(out));\n    }\n\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- the game\n\n    /// @notice Lends `amount` cUSDC (the public bound of a run) into the game for a new run.\n    ///         Returns what actually moved: `amount`, or 0 if the reserve is short (encrypted).\n    function lend(uint256 runId, uint64 amount) external onlyGame returns (euint64 lent) {\n        if (lockedAssets + amount > syncedAssets) revert ReserveFull(lockedAssets + amount, syncedAssets);\n        euint64 a = FHE.asEuint64(amount);\n        FHE.allowTransient(a, address(asset));\n        lent = asset.confidentialTransfer(msg.sender, a);\n        _outstanding = FHE.add(_outstanding, lent);\n        FHE.allowThis(_outstanding);\n        FHE.allow(lent, msg.sender);\n        lockedAssets += amount;\n        ++openLoans;\n        emit Lent(runId, FHE.toBytes32(lent), lockedAssets);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice The game sent the run's `stake + lent - payout` back; books the loan as closed.\n    function repaid(uint256 runId, uint64 amount, euint64 lent, euint64 interest) external onlyGame {\n        _outstanding = FHE.sub(_outstanding, lent);\n        _interest = FHE.add(_interest, interest);\n        FHE.allowThis(_outstanding);\n        FHE.allowThis(_interest);\n        lockedAssets -= amount;\n        --openLoans;\n        emit Repaid(runId, lockedAssets);\n    }\n\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- sync\n\n    /// @notice Permissionless: makes the current totals publicly decryptable (assets = cUSDC held\n    ///         + lent to live runs; shares; interest earned). At most every `SYNC_INTERVAL`.\n    function requestSync() external {\n        uint64 nowTs = uint64(block.timestamp);\n        if (syncRequestedAt != 0 && nowTs < syncRequestedAt + SYNC_TIMEOUT) revert SyncTooSoon(syncRequestedAt + SYNC_TIMEOUT);\n        if (syncedAt != 0 && nowTs < syncedAt + SYNC_INTERVAL) revert SyncTooSoon(syncedAt + SYNC_INTERVAL);\n        euint64 assets = FHE.add(asset.confidentialBalanceOf(address(this)), _outstanding);\n        euint64 interest = FHE.add(_interest, FHE.asEuint64(0)); // a handle even before the first run\n        euint64 supply = FHE.add(confidentialTotalSupply(), FHE.asEuint64(0));\n        FHE.makePubliclyDecryptable(assets);\n        FHE.makePubliclyDecryptable(supply);\n        FHE.makePubliclyDecryptable(interest);\n        _pending = [FHE.toBytes32(assets), FHE.toBytes32(supply), FHE.toBytes32(interest)];\n        syncRequestedAt = nowTs;\n        emit SyncRequested(nowTs, _pending[0], _pending[1], _pending[2]);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Permissionless: records the decrypted totals with the KMS proof.\n    function finalizeSync(uint64 assets, uint64 shares, uint64 interest, bytes calldata proof) external {\n        if (syncRequestedAt == 0) revert NoSyncPending();\n        bytes32[] memory handles = new bytes32[](3);\n        (handles[0], handles[1], handles[2]) = (_pending[0], _pending[1], _pending[2]);\n        FHE.checkSignatures(handles, abi.encode(assets, shares, interest), proof);\n        (syncedAssets, syncedShares, syncedInterest, syncedAt) = (assets, shares, interest, syncRequestedAt);\n        syncRequestedAt = 0;\n        emit Synced(syncedAt, assets, shares, interest);\n    }\n\n    function pendingSync() external view returns (bytes32 assets, bytes32 shares, bytes32 interest) {\n        return (_pending[0], _pending[1], _pending[2]);\n    }\n\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- views\n\n    /// @notice Interest on a borrowed amount: `paid x aprBps x borrowedTenthSeconds / (1e4 x 10 x YEAR)`.\n    ///         The divisor of the rate, for the game.\n    function interestDivisor() external pure returns (uint64) {\n        return uint64(10_000 * 10 * YEAR);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Share price with 6 decimals (1_000_000 = 1 cUSDC per share), from the last sync.\n    function sharePrice() external view returns (uint256) {\n        return syncedShares == 0 ? 1e6 : (uint256(syncedAssets) * 1e6) / syncedShares;\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Committed liquidity over synced assets, in basis points.\n    function utilizationBps() external view returns (uint256) {\n        return syncedAssets == 0 ? 0 : (lockedAssets * 10_000) / syncedAssets;\n    }\n\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- internals\n\n    function _toShares(euint64 assets) private returns (euint64) {\n        if (syncedShares == 0 || syncedAssets == 0) return assets;\n        return FHE.asEuint64(FHE.div(FHE.mul(FHE.asEuint128(assets), uint128(syncedShares)), uint128(syncedAssets)));\n    }\n\n    function _toAssets(euint64 shares) private returns (euint64) {\n        if (syncedShares == 0) return shares;\n        return FHE.asEuint64(FHE.div(FHE.mul(FHE.asEuint128(shares), uint128(syncedAssets)), uint128(syncedShares)));\n    }\n}\n","keccak256":"0xa846d309d57d6e2e15e9907c75390866775189d044b1963df3087223c54544b6","license":"BSD-3-Clause-Clear"},"contracts/Siroclimb.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-3-Clause-Clear\npragma solidity ^0.8.27;\n\nimport {FHE, ebool, euint8, euint32, euint64, externalEbool, externalEuint64} from \"@fhevm/solidity/lib/FHE.sol\";\nimport {ZamaEthereumConfig} from \"@fhevm/solidity/config/ZamaConfig.sol\";\nimport {Ownable2Step, Ownable} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable2Step.sol\";\nimport {ECDSA} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/cryptography/ECDSA.sol\";\nimport {MessageHashUtils} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/cryptography/MessageHashUtils.sol\";\nimport {IERC7984} from \"@openzeppelin/confidential-contracts/interfaces/IERC7984.sol\";\nimport {ClimbPriceOracle} from \"./ClimbPriceOracle.sol\";\nimport {ClimbLadder} from \"./ClimbLadder.sol\";\nimport {SiroccoReserve} from \"./SiroccoReserve.sol\";\nimport {SiroccoDesk} from \"./SiroccoDesk.sol\";\n\n/// @title Siroclimb\n/// @notice The Sirocco climbing game on the Zama Protocol: pick a market, go long or short, the\n///         leverage climbs from 1x to 4x every 6 seconds over a 60 second run, cash out whenever.\n///\n/// What is confidential (see README, \"Confidentiality design\"):\n///  - the side (long / short) of every run is an encrypted `ebool`: nobody can copy or fade a\n///    player;\n///  - the stake of a run is an encrypted `euint64` in Zama's confidential USDC (ERC-7984);\n///  - a run's value is computed on ciphertexts: the contract computes, in clear, what a long and\n///    a short would have made on the public oracle path (`multLong`, `multShort`), then picks one\n///    with the encrypted side (`FHE.select`) and multiplies the encrypted stake by it. The payout\n///    is an encrypted transfer in the same transaction: money never waits for a decryption;\n///  - leverage is borrowed from the Sirocco Reserve (`SiroccoReserve`), a confidential cUSDC lending\n///    pool: a run of stake S at leverage L borrows S x (L - 1), and pays interest on it for the\n///    time it is borrowed. The borrowed amount and the interest follow the encrypted stake, so they\n///    stay encrypted; the reserve commits liquidity in clear with the public bound of a run;\n///  - every run holds a real position in its market's confidential token, traded with the Sirocco\n///    desk (`SiroccoDesk`) at the oracle price plus or minus a spread: stake + borrowed cUSDC\n///    (`POSITION_LEVERAGE` x the stake) buys the token for a long; a short borrows the token from the\n///    desk and sells it. At the end the long sells, the short buys back and returns, the loan and its\n///    interest go back to the reserve. Quantities and cash legs are encrypted, and both legs of every\n///    trade move whatever the side (one with an encrypted 0);\n///  - the payout keeps the game's amplification: every move counts `moveScale(market)` times on the ladder\n///    (`ClimbLadder`). The part of the payout beyond the real position (\"game boost\", positive or\n///    negative) is settled with the reserve, encrypted; the player can decrypt both parts;\n///  - leverage packs are drawn with the on-chain encrypted PRNG and stay private: a packed run's\n///    leverage cap is selected on ciphertexts.\n///\n/// Every lifecycle step after a player's own action is permissionless (`settleRun`, `recordRun`,\n/// price pushes), so the players' browsers can run the game with nothing else.\ncontract Siroclimb is ZamaEthereumConfig, Ownable2Step {\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- constants\n\n    uint8 public constant TOP_STEP = 6;\n    uint64 public constant STEP_SECONDS = 6;\n    uint64 public constant RUN_SECONDS = 60;\n    /// @notice A run that reaches its 60th second exits on the first checkpoint written in the\n    ///         `EXIT_GRACE` seconds after its end, if any (else the last one before it): the player's\n    ///         browser writes the price it showed at the 60th second, then settles, in the same block.\n    ///         Without it the exit was the last checkpoint before the end, seconds older than the screen.\n    uint64 public constant EXIT_GRACE = 30;\n    /// @notice Multipliers are fixed point with 6 decimals: 1_000_000 = the stake back.\n    uint32 public constant SCALE = 1_000_000;\n    uint32 public constant MAX_MULT = 10 * SCALE;\n    uint64 public constant MAX_STAKE = 100_000_000; // 100 cUSDC (6 decimals)\n    uint64 public constant MAX_PAYOUT = (MAX_STAKE * MAX_MULT) / SCALE;\n    /// @notice The entry price of a run must be at most this old (Sepolia inclusion can take\n    ///         a few blocks); a fallback price can ride along to refresh it in the same transaction.\n    uint64 public constant MAX_ENTRY_AGE = 60;\n    uint64 public constant PACK_COOLDOWN = 10 minutes;\n    /// @notice The real position of a run: stake + borrowed cUSDC = this many times the stake, held\n    ///         from the start to the end (the borrowed part is (POSITION_LEVERAGE - 1) x the stake).\n    uint64 public constant POSITION_LEVERAGE = 4;\n\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- types\n\n    enum RunStatus {\n        None,\n        Live,\n        Ended\n    }\n\n    struct Run {\n        address player;\n        uint8 market;\n        RunStatus status;\n        bool packed;\n        uint8 topStep; // ladder step reached at the exit (before any pack cap)\n        uint64 startAt;\n        uint64 endAt;\n        uint64 entryPrice;\n        uint64 exitPrice;\n        uint32 multLong; // public at the end: value / stake for a long (6 decimals), uncapped ladder\n        uint32 multShort; // same for a short\n        uint32 entryIndex; // oracle checkpoint of the entry\n        uint32 exitIndex; // last oracle checkpoint counted (written at or before the exit, known at settlement)\n        bool publishRequested;\n        bool published;\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Encrypted part of a run. Handles are public, plaintexts are ACL protected.\n    struct Sealed {\n        ebool long;\n        euint64 paid; // stake actually transferred (ERC-7984 moves 0 on insufficient balance)\n        euint64 value; // payout of the run (net of interest)\n        euint64 lent; // liquidity the reserve lent for the run: MAX_PAYOUT, or 0 if it was short\n        euint64 interest; // borrow interest charged at the end\n        euint32 mult; // the player's own multiplier (selected with the encrypted side)\n        euint8 cap; // packed runs: encrypted top ladder step\n        euint64 qty; // market tokens held (long) or owed to the desk (short)\n        euint64 cashLeg; // long: cUSDC paid for them; short: cUSDC the sale brought in\n        euint64 position; // what the real position is worth at the end: stake + sale - cost - interest, floored at 0\n    }\n\n    struct Result {\n        address player;\n        uint64 timestamp;\n        int32 pnlPpm; // value / stake - 1, in millionths\n        uint32 runId;\n    }\n\n    struct SessionGrant {\n        address player;\n        uint64 expiry;\n    }\n\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- storage\n\n    IERC7984 public immutable token;\n    ClimbPriceOracle public immutable oracle;\n    /// @notice The ladder rules: what a long and a short make on the oracle path of a run.\n    ClimbLadder public immutable ladder;\n    /// @notice The Sirocco Reserve: lends the leverage of every run, receives its PnL and interest.\n    SiroccoReserve public immutable reserve;\n    /// @notice The Sirocco desk: real trades of the market tokens for every run's position.\n    SiroccoDesk public immutable desk;\n    /// @notice Borrow rate (reserve's APR in basis points) and its divisor, see `interestOf`.\n    uint64 public immutable borrowAprBps;\n    uint64 public immutable interestDivisor;\n    uint256 public immutable marketCount;\n\n    /// @notice The confidential token of each market (cTSLAx, cNVDAx, cAAPLx, cAMZNx, cXAUt, ctGBP).\n    IERC7984[] public marketTokens;\n\n    Run[] private _runs;\n    mapping(uint256 runId => Sealed) private _sealed;\n    Result[] private _results;\n\n    mapping(address player => string) public nameOf;\n    mapping(address session => SessionGrant) public sessions;\n    mapping(address player => address) public sessionOf;\n\n    mapping(address player => euint8) private _packTier;\n    mapping(address player => bool) public hasPack;\n    mapping(address player => uint64) public lastPackAt;\n\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- errors / events\n\n    error UnknownMarket(uint256 market);\n    error BadLadder();\n    error NotPlayer(uint256 runId);\n    error WrongRunStatus(uint256 runId);\n    error RunNotOver(uint256 runId, uint256 endsAt);\n    error StaleEntry(uint256 market, uint256 checkpointAt);\n    error NoPack();\n    error PackCooldown(uint256 availableAt);\n    error BadSession();\n    error NameTooLong();\n    error AlreadyPublished(uint256 runId);\n\n    event SessionAuthorized(address indexed player, address indexed session, uint64 expiry);\n    event SessionRevoked(address indexed player, address indexed session);\n    event NameSet(address indexed player, string name);\n    event RunStarted(\n        uint256 indexed runId,\n        address indexed player,\n        uint8 market,\n        uint64 startAt,\n        uint64 entryPrice,\n        bool packed,\n        bytes32 sideHandle,\n        bytes32 paidHandle\n    );\n    event RunEnded(\n        uint256 indexed runId,\n        address indexed player,\n        uint64 endAt,\n        uint64 exitPrice,\n        uint32 multLong,\n        uint32 multShort,\n        bytes32 valueHandle\n    );\n    event ResultRecorded(uint256 indexed index, address indexed player, int32 pnlPpm, uint32 runId);\n    event PackOpened(address indexed player, bytes32 tierHandle);\n    event PublishRequested(uint256 indexed runId, bytes32 multHandle);\n    event Borrowed(uint256 indexed runId, bytes32 lentHandle);\n    event InterestCharged(uint256 indexed runId, bytes32 interestHandle);\n    event PositionOpened(uint256 indexed runId, address indexed token, uint64 price, bytes32 qtyHandle, bytes32 cashHandle);\n    event PositionClosed(uint256 indexed runId, uint64 price, bytes32 positionHandle);\n\n    constructor(\n        address owner_,\n        IERC7984 token_,\n        ClimbLadder ladder_,\n        SiroccoReserve reserve_,\n        SiroccoDesk desk_,\n        IERC7984[] memory marketTokens_\n    ) Ownable(owner_) {\n        token = token_;\n        ladder = ladder_;\n        reserve = reserve_;\n        desk = desk_;\n        oracle = ladder_.oracle();\n        marketCount = oracle.marketCount();\n        borrowAprBps = reserve_.borrowAprBps();\n        interestDivisor = reserve_.interestDivisor();\n        if (ladder_.SCALE() != SCALE || ladder_.MAX_MULT() != MAX_MULT) revert BadLadder();\n        if (address(reserve_.asset()) != address(token_)) revert BadLadder();\n        if (address(desk_.cash()) != address(token_) || marketTokens_.length != marketCount) revert BadLadder();\n        // the desk pulls the runs' legs itself (ERC-7984 operator of the game's cUSDC and market tokens)\n        token_.setOperator(address(desk_), type(uint48).max);\n        for (uint256 i; i < marketTokens_.length; ++i) {\n            marketTokens.push(marketTokens_[i]);\n            marketTokens_[i].setOperator(address(desk_), type(uint48).max);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- players and sessions\n\n    /// @notice Lets a browser session key act for the caller (start runs, cash out),\n    ///         so a run needs no wallet pop-up. The session proves it consents by signing\n    ///         `sessionDigest(player, expiry)`. Any ETH sent is forwarded to the session for gas.\n    ///         A session can only play with the stake the player approved (ERC-7984 operator);\n    ///         it can never withdraw.\n    function authorizeSession(address session, uint64 expiry, bytes calldata sessionSig) external payable {\n        if (session == address(0) || session == msg.sender || sessions[msg.sender].player != address(0)) revert BadSession();\n        bytes32 digest = MessageHashUtils.toEthSignedMessageHash(sessionDigest(msg.sender, expiry));\n        if (ECDSA.recover(digest, sessionSig) != session) revert BadSession();\n        address previous = sessionOf[msg.sender];\n        if (previous != address(0) && previous != session) delete sessions[previous];\n        SessionGrant storage existing = sessions[session];\n        if (existing.player != address(0) && existing.player != msg.sender) sessionOf[existing.player] = address(0);\n        sessions[session] = SessionGrant({player: msg.sender, expiry: expiry});\n        sessionOf[msg.sender] = session;\n        emit SessionAuthorized(msg.sender, session, expiry);\n        if (msg.value != 0) {\n            (bool ok, ) = session.call{value: msg.value}(\"\");\n            ok;\n        }\n    }\n\n    function revokeSession() external {\n        address session = sessionOf[msg.sender];\n        if (session == address(0)) revert BadSession();\n        delete sessions[session];\n        delete sessionOf[msg.sender];\n        emit SessionRevoked(msg.sender, session);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice What a session key signs (EIP-191) to accept acting for `player`.\n    function sessionDigest(address player, uint64 expiry) public view returns (bytes32) {\n        return keccak256(abi.encodePacked(\"Siroclimb session\", block.chainid, address(this), player, expiry));\n    }\n\n    /// @notice The player a caller acts for: the session's player, or the caller itself.\n    function playerOf(address caller) public view returns (address) {\n        SessionGrant storage s = sessions[caller];\n        if (s.player != address(0) && s.expiry >= block.timestamp) return s.player;\n        return caller;\n    }\n\n    function setName(string calldata name_) external {\n        if (bytes(name_).length > 24) revert NameTooLong();\n        address player = playerOf(msg.sender);\n        nameOf[player] = name_;\n        emit NameSet(player, name_);\n    }\n\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- runs\n\n    /// @notice Opens a run. A signed Pyth update can ride along so the entry is fresh; for a\n    ///         market Pyth does not cover, a public price can ride along instead (the oracle's\n    ///         bounds apply, exactly as for `pushPublic`).\n    function startRun(\n        uint8 market,\n        externalEbool side,\n        externalEuint64 stake,\n        bytes calldata inputProof,\n        bool usePack,\n        bytes[] calldata pythUpdate,\n        uint64 fallbackPrice\n    ) external payable returns (uint256 runId) {\n        if (market >= marketCount) revert UnknownMarket(market);\n        if _runs.push();\n        Run storage r = _runs[runId];\n        r.player = player;\n        r.market = market;\n        r.status = RunStatus.Live;\n        r.startAt = uint64(block.timestamp);\n        r.entryPrice = price;\n        r.entryIndex = uint32(index);\n\n        Sealed storage s = _sealed[runId];\n        s.long = FHE.fromExternal(side, inputProof);\n        euint64 amount = _own(s.long, player);\n        _own64(s.paid, player);\n\n        if (usePack) {\n            if (!hasPack[player]) revert NoPack();\n            hasPack[player] = false;\n            r.packed = FHE.eq(t, 0),\n                FHE.asEuint8(1),\n                FHE.select(FHE.eq(t, 1), FHE.asEuint8(2), FHE.select(FHE.eq(t, 2), FHE.asEuint8(4), FHE.asEuint8(6)))\n            );\n            FHE.allowThis(s.cap);\n            FHE.allow(s.cap, player);\n        }\n\n        // the leverage: the reserve lends the run's public bound into the game (encrypted transfer)\n        s.lent = Written as\n    ///        the market's checkpoint in this block, bounded like a public price (+/-0.49 % of the last\n    ///        checkpoint), and the run exits on it: the player is paid the value end) revert RunNotOver(runId, end);\n        bool wrote = r.player == playerOf(msg.sender) && block.timestamp <= end + EXIT_GRACE && _writeExit(r.market, exitPrice);\n        _endRun(runId, end, ZamaProtocolUnsupported().notice: Returned if the Zama protocol is not supported on the current chain

PublicDecryptionVerified(bytes32[],bytes.notice: This event is emitted when public decryption has been successfully verified.

EXIT_GRACE().notice: A run that reaches its 60th second exits on the first checkpoint written in the         `EXIT_GRACE` seconds after its end, if any (else the last one before it): the player's         browser writes the price it showed at the 60th second, then settles, in the same block.         Without it the exit was the last checkpoint before the end, seconds older than the screen.

MAX_ENTRY_AGE().notice: The entry price of a run must be at most this old (Sepolia inclusion can take         a few blocks); a fallback price can ride along to refresh it in the same transaction.

POSITION_LEVERAGE().notice: The real position of a run: stake + borrowed cUSDC = this many times the stake, held         from the start to the end (the borrowed part is (POSITION_LEVERAGE - 1) x the stake).

SCALE().notice: Multipliers are fixed point with 6 decimals: 1_000_000 = the stake back.

authorizeSession(address,uint64,bytes).notice: Lets a browser session key act for the caller (start runs, cash out),         so a run needs no wallet pop-up. The session proves it consents by signing         `sessionDigest(player, expiry)`. Any ETH sent is forwarded to the session for gas.         A session can only play with the stake the player approved (ERC-7984 operator);         it can never withdraw.

borrowAprBps().notice: Borrow rate (reserve's APR in basis points) and its divisor, see `interestOf`.

borrowedTenthSeconds(uint64).notice: What a run borrows over `elapsed` seconds, in leverage tenths x seconds: the position         borrows (POSITION_LEVERAGE - 1) x the stake for the whole run (30 tenths at 4x).         Interest = paid x borrowAprBps x this / interestDivisor.

cashOut(uint256,bytes[],uint64).notice: Ends the caller's run now and pays it in the same transaction. A signed Pyth         update can ride along so the exit is the freshest verified price.

desk().notice: The Sirocco desk: real trades of the market tokens for every run's position.

ladder().notice: The ladder rules: what a long and a short make on the oracle path of a run.

marketTokens(uint256).notice: The confidential token of each market (cTSLAx, cNVDAx, cAAPLx, cAMZNx, cXAUt, ctGBP).

openPack().notice: Draws a leverage pack with the FHEVM encrypted PRNG. The tier stays encrypted         (only the player can decrypt it): Bronze 45 %, Silver 28 %, Gold 18 %, Diamond 9 %.         A packed run caps its ladder at the pack's leverage, selected on ciphertexts.

playerOf(address).notice: The player a caller acts for: the session's player, or the caller itself.

positionHandles(uint256).notice: Handles of a run's real position: market tokens held (long) or owed (short), its cash leg,         and what the position was worth at the end. Player only.

publishRun(uint256).notice: Owner of a finished run: reveal its result for the leaderboard. Makes the         run's multiplier publicly decryptable (the stake stays private).

recordRun(uint256,uint32,bytes).notice: Permissionless: records a published run with the KMS decryption proof.

reserve().notice: The Sirocco Reserve: lends the leverage of every run, receives its PnL and interest.

sessionDigest(address,uint64).notice: What a session key signs (EIP-191) to accept acting for `player`.

settleRun(uint256,uint64).notice: Permissionless: settles a run whose 60 seconds are over, at its last second.         `exitPrice`: from the player (or their session) only, the price their screen showed at the 60th         second, written as the exit checkpoint (bounded, see cashOut) when settled within `EXIT_GRACE`.         Anyone else's call settles on the checkpoints as they are.

startRun(uint8,bytes32,bytes32,bytes,boo.notice: Opens a run. Side and stake are encrypted inputs (bound to the caller); the         stake is clamped to `MAX_STAKE` on ciphertexts and pulled from the player as an         ERC-7984 operator. A signed Pyth update can ride along so the entry is fresh; for a         market Pyth does not cover, a public price can ride along instead (the oracle's         bounds apply, exactly as for `pushPublic`).

userdoc.notice: The Sirocco climbing game on the Zama Protocol: pick a market, go long or short, the         leverage climbs from 1x to 4x every 6 seconds over a 60 second run, cash out whenever. What is confidential (see README, "Confidentiality design"):  - the side (long / short) of every run is an encrypted `ebool`: nobody can copy or fade a    player;  - the stake of a run is an encrypted `euint64` in Zama's confidential USDC (ERC-7984);  - a run's value is computed on ciphertexts: the contract computes, in clear, what a long and    a short would have made on the public oracle path (`multLong`, `multShort`), then picks one    with the encrypted side (`FHE.select`) and multiplies the encrypted stake by it. The payout    is an encrypted transfer in the same transaction: money never waits for a decryption;  - leverage is borrowed from the Sirocco Reserve (`SiroccoReserve`), a confidential cUSDC lending    pool: a run of stake S at leverage L borrows S x (L - 1), and pays interest on it for the    time it is borrowed. The borrowed amount and the interest follow the encrypted stake, so they    stay encrypted; the reserve commits liquidity in clear with the public bound of a run;  - every run holds a real position in its market's confidential token, traded with the Sirocco    desk (`SiroccoDesk`) at the oracle price plus or minus a spread: stake + borrowed cUSDC    (`POSITION_LEVERAGE` x the stake) buys the token for a long; a short borrows the token from the    desk and sells it. At the end the long sells, the short buys back and returns, the loan and its    interest go back to the reserve. Quantities and cash legs are encrypted, and both legs of every    trade move whatever the side (one with an encrypted 0);  - the payout keeps the game's amplification: every move counts `moveScale(market)` times on the ladder    (`ClimbLadder`). The part of the payout beyond the real position ("game boost", positive or    negative) is settled with the reserve, encrypted; the player can decrypt both parts;  - leverage packs are drawn with the on-chain encrypted PRNG and stay private: a packed run's    leverage cap is selected on ciphertexts. Every lifecycle step after a player's own action is permissionless (`settleRun`, `recordRun`, price pushes), so the players' browsers can run the game with nothing else.
